blocks.html: An ADU detached from the primary dwelling shall be constructed in accordance with the New York City Zoning Resolution and all requirements of Group R-3 occupancy in this code, except as provided by Section U103, Sections U203.2 and U203.4 through U203.7, and Section U204.2.
